description:
US-002 lists close among the e.g. mutations that should advance updatedAt. specify/abandon/demote/merge(source+target)/rank all have explicit updatedAt-bump tests; closeIssueOnMain stamps updatedAt (issue-specify.ts:562) but has no dedicated updatedAt-bump assertion. Non-blocking (illustrative e.g., writer is structurally identical and implemented).

Source: cam/issue-284

Location: test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts

acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated test in test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts asserts that closeIssueOnMain bumps the issue's updatedAt timestamp on close.
The assertion mirrors the existing dedicated updatedAt-bump tests for specify/abandon/demote/merge(source+target)/rank.
The new test drives the real closeIssueOnMain writer (issue-specify.ts:562) and passes.
spec.scope: Add one dedicated updatedAt-bump test for closeIssueOnMain in test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts, mirroring the existing per-mutation updatedAt assertions. Test-only change; do not modify closeIssueOnMain (it already stamps updatedAt correctly).
gotchas: closeIssueOnMain is structurally identical to the other mutation writers and already stamps updatedAt; this closes a test-coverage gap only, not a behavior bug.
Match the fixture/clock setup the sibling updatedAt-bump tests use so the assertion is deterministic.
